title: Hearty Ukrainian Hazelnut Sandwich
description: A post-workout Ukrainian dish featuring shelled hazelnuts and double-rise-bread, this sandwich is low-fat-friendly and packed with nutrients to help with recovery. It has a grassy and chewy texture from the fresh herbs and whole grain bread.
instructions: Preheat a panini press to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Lay out the slices of double-rise-bread on a clean surface.
Spread one tablespoon of low-fat cream cheese on each slice of bread.
Top the cream cheese with chopped shelled hazelnuts, sliced cucumber, chopped fresh dill, and shredded lettuce.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Place the slices of bread in the panini press and cook for 4 minutes.
Remove the sandwiches from the press and let them cool for 2 minutes.
Serve the sandwiches warm and enjoy.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours.
